content_text: Log-C gamma is meant to emulate film negative scans but I think it’s applied to Arriraw conversions / debayering to RGB for color-correction, it’s not the 12-bit log storage format of Arriraw. ARRI ‘s own website is not completely clear on this but I believe we’re talking about two different things, the Log-C used for debayered images and the mathematical log used for data storage in Arriraw.
